QUOTE: `library/common.h:132` defines `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` unconditionally. Library translation units that include `common.h` get `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` expanding to plain `x`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that library code turns the opt-out on in the shared header common.h, so library TUs see plain member names.
